o.t: Inside information: Kempower initiates change negotiations in Finland as part of its plans to restructure its organization and renew its operating model
Inside information, negative profit warning: Kempower lowers its revenue and operative EBIT outlook for 2026 and publishes preliminary Q3 2026 figures
r: L'entreprise abaisse ses objectifs : elle s'attend à moins bien que prévu.
